Ahmed Basil.note: Fadhil stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Another aspect is how Fadhil leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Ahmed Basil.noteZh: 看Ahmed Basil Fadhil的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Ahmed Maknzi.summary: Ahmed Maknzi is an Iraq left-back from Al-Karma who gives the national team wide defending, recovery runs, and defensive flexibility.
Ahmed Maknzi.note: For Maknzi, the foundation is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Look first at how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. Separately, look at how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ahmed Maknzi.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者是理解Ahmed Maknzi踢法的关键。先看他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ahmed Qasem.note: For Qasem, the foundation is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Look first at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ahmed Qasem.noteZh: Ahmed Qasem的比赛建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动之上。首先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Aimar Sher.note: The key to Sher is carrying momentum through open midfield. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. In another phase, Sher angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Aimar Sher.noteZh: 观察Aimar Sher时，可以先看带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个比赛细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Akam Hashim.note: The key to Hashem is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate part of his game is how Hashem holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Akam Hashim.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Akam Hashem踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ali Al-Hamadi.summary: Ali Al-Hamadi is an Iraq centre-forward from Luton Town who gives the national team hold-up play, runs in behind, and penalty-box finishing.
Ali Al-Hamadi.note: Al-Hamadi stands out for making the next teammate's action easier. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Al-Hamadi also moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ali Al-Hamadi.noteZh: Ali Al-Hamadi的比赛建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松之上。首先看他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Ali Jasim.note: Watch Jasim for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. The clearest example is how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Elsewhere, Jasim draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Ali Jasim.noteZh: Ali Jasim最鲜明的特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。一个直接线索是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Ali Yousif.note: Yousif stands out for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. In a separate phase, Yousif arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Ali Yousif.noteZh: 最能体现Ali Yousif特点的是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。这一点直接体现在他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。除此之外，他也会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Amir Al-Ammari.summary: Amir Al-Ammari is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Cracovia who gives the national team screening, left-footed passing, and set-piece support.
Amir Al-Ammari.note: Al-Ammari's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. Away from that moment, he plays the available pass with his left foot.
Amir Al-Ammari.noteZh: Amir Al-Ammari最鲜明的特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。一个直接线索是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个独立细节是他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Aymen Hussein.note: What separates Hussein is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Hussein starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. At another point, he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Aymen Hussein.noteZh: 看Aymen Hussein的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Fahad Talib.note: What separates Talib is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. Talib keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. A separate detail appears when he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Fahad Talib.noteZh: 射门方向明确前保持身体平衡构成Fahad Talib踢法的核心。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Frans Putros.note: Putros's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Watch how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He also protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Frans Putros.noteZh: Frans Putros的比赛建立在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构之上。首先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个方面是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Hussein Ali.note: Watch Ali for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. A separate question is whether Ali pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Hussein Ali.noteZh: Hussein Ali的比赛建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑之上。首先看他如何在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Ibrahim Bayesh.note: For Bayesh, the foundation is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Look first at how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Beyond the first action, he uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Ibrahim Bayesh.noteZh: 观察Ibrahim Bayesh时，可以先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个比赛细节是他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Jalal Hassan.note: The key to Hassan is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. One more thing to notice is how Hassan sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Jalal Hassan.noteZh: 观察Jalal Hassan时，可以先看危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个比赛细节是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Kevin Yakob.note: For Yakob, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Kevin Yakob.noteZh: 理解Kevin Yakob，要先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Marko Farji.note: What separates Farji is explosive speed once open grass appears. Farji changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase of play, he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Marko Farji.noteZh: 看Marko Farji的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Merchas Doski.note: Doski's signature is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Watch how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. At another point in the move, he turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Merchas Doski.noteZh: 理解Merchas Doski，要先看封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Mohanad Ali.note: Watch Ali for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also watch how Ali arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Mohanad Ali.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Mohanad Ali踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Munaf Younus.note: Younis stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. Another aspect is how Younis absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Munaf Younus.noteZh: Manaf Younis的优势在于先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。最直接的表现是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个值得观察的细节是他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Mustafa Saadoon.summary: Mustafa Saadoon is an Iraq right-back from Al-Shorta who gives the national team wide defending, recovery speed, and overlap support.
Mustafa Saadoon.note: Saadoon's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Mustafa Saadoon.noteZh: Mustafa Saadoon最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Rebin Sulaka.note: The key to Sulaka is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In another phase, Sulaka slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Rebin Sulaka.noteZh: Rebin Sulaka最鲜明的特点是危险出现前组织好队友。一个直接线索是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Youssef Amyn.note: What separates Amyn is explosive speed once open grass appears. Amyn changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. A separate detail appears when he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Youssef Amyn.noteZh: 看Youssef Amyn的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Zaid Ismail.summary: Zaid Ismail is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Al-Talaba who gives the national team screening, duel work, and simple central passing.
Zaid Ismail.note: Ismail stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Ismail also holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Zaid Ismail.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Zaid Ismail踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Zaid Tahseen.note: Watch Tahseen for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. In a different phase, Tahseen meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Zaid Tahseen.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Zaid Tahseen踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Zidane Iqbal.note: Iqbal's signature is carrying momentum through open midfield. Watch how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Away from that moment, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Zidane Iqbal.noteZh: 最能体现Zidane Iqbal特点的是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。这一点直接体现在他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。除此之外，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。
